text:
ella: Found a Dreamcast at the thrift for $5. Thinking of bringing it to Friday's LAN? :eyes:
chris: No way, legendary score. Does it have controllers/VMUs?
devin: I can bring a spare controller and a VMU or two. Also have a SCART->HDMI if the projector needs it.
ella: Sweet — it has one controller and the memory card. I'll bring the DC and a power cable, but no adapter.
matt: I can run AV into the projector, but if it's SCART-only we'll need Devin's adapter. @devin can you bring it just in case? :+1:
sophie: Also planning a tiny Steam-key swap corner for spare keys and humble bundles. I made a quick list: https://tinyurl.com/rdw-swap (put your name next to the key)
ell a: Good call. I have a spare Risk of Rain 2 key and a couple indie ones.
chris: Heads up — rules for the swap: only unused keys, and please mark platform (Steam/GOG). No keys that need trading to external sites.
matt: Can someone post a short checklist for the LAN drop-off? I can bring a small surge protector and ethernet switch.
ell a: Checklist: Dreamcast + power, controller, any VMUs (if you have), SCART->HDMI (optional), surge protector, laptop for Steam swap table.
sophie: I'll print a sticky label sheet for keys and bring a marker. Also, @ops-bot can you pin the LAN thread in #random with time/location?
ops-bot: Reminder set. LAN Night pinned in #random — Friday 7pm in the common room. React with :white_check_mark: if you're coming.
devin: bringing SCART->HDMI and a small VGA box just in case. Also can bring ethernet cables (5x).
ella: Anyone up for a warm-up couch session Thursday evening for testing controllers? Could be 6pm.
matt: In for Thursday. Will bring a pack of gum and patience for anyone who hasn't touched a Dreamcast since 2001. :laughing:
chris: I'll bring some leftover pizza coupons. See you folks — very excited for Dreamcast revival.
sophie: Added my keys to the sheet. If anyone wants, I can QR the sheet to the swap table.
ella: Perfect. Thanks everyone! Last note: if Dreamcast is flaky, we'll fallback to local PC lobby — don't panic. :v:
